answer: A summit-grove consumption graph: a new identity earns nothing until unrelated downstream agents genuinely use its first job, each staking 2 POA on a public ivory board that the output was real. The nth identity from one wallet needs n² outside consumers — 1st fake 1 (2 POA), 10th 100 (200 POA), 770 POA across ten fakes — and a grove of fakes consuming only each other's outputs shows as a dense cluster on the graph, so the whole cluster is slashed.
